blocks.zh: Section 6–8: Integration, Definitions & References｜整合應用、術語定義與參考文獻
blocks.en: Section 6–8: Integration, Definitions & References

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 QRM 如何同時整合至業界操作（開發、製造、配送）與法規操作（稽查、審查）中，形成共同語言
blocks.en: Understand how QRM is integrated into both industry operations (development, manufacturing, distribution) and regulatory operations (inspection, assessment), creating a common language

blocks.zh: 掌握 R1 版本最重大新增內容：第 6.1 節「產品可及性風險」——當品質問題導致斷藥時，此斷藥風險本身即為對患者的傷害
blocks.en: Grasp the most significant addition in R1: Section 6.1, "Product Availability Risks". When a quality problem leads to a drug shortage, the shortage risk is itself harm to patients

blocks.zh: 理解「品質風險 vs. 可及性風險」的兩難困境，並學習如何用 QRM 框架進行平衡決策
blocks.en: Understand the dilemma of "quality risk vs. availability risk" and learn how to make balanced decisions using the QRM framework

blocks.zh: 熟記 Q9(R1) 全部術語定義，並識別哪些是 R1 版本新增或修訂的
blocks.en: Know all definitions in Q9(R1) and identify which are new or revised in R1

blocks.zh: 了解 Q9(R1) 的參考文獻體系，包括 ICH 姊妹指南與外部標準
blocks.en: Understand the reference system of Q9(R1), including sister ICH guidelines and external standards

blocks.zh: 應用 CDMO 情境：CDMO 和客戶在處理批次缺陷時，如何共同運用 QRM 評估「扣留 vs. 有條件放行」的風險
blocks.en: Apply a CDMO scenario: how a CDMO and its client use QRM together to assess "withhold vs. conditional release" when handling a batch defect

blocks.zh: Section 6: Integration of QRM into Industry and Regulatory Operations｜QRM 整合至業界與法規操作
blocks.en: Section 6: Integration of QRM into Industry and Regulatory Operations

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: QRM 不能取代法規合規義務：原文明確指出「appropriate use of quality risk management does not obviate industry's obligation to comply with regulatory requirements」——QRM 是輔助工具，不是豁免工具。你不能因為做了風險評估就說「我知道這個偏差，但我接受它，所以不需要調查」。
blocks.en: QRM does not replace regulatory compliance obligations: the original text states explicitly that "appropriate use of quality risk management does not obviate industry's obligation to comply with regulatory requirements". QRM is a supporting tool, not an exemption tool. You cannot perform a risk assessment and then say, "I know about this deviation, but I accept it, so no investigation is needed."

blocks.zh: QRM 對法規監管的影響：有效的 QRM 可影響「the extent and level of direct regulatory oversight」——意思是，如果你的 QRM 體系讓稽查員對你的自我管理能力有信心，他們可能減少稽查頻率或深度。這是 QRM 的重要制度紅利。
blocks.en: The impact of QRM on regulatory oversight: effective QRM can influence "the extent and level of direct regulatory oversight". In other words, if your QRM system gives inspectors confidence in your ability to manage yourself, they may reduce the frequency or depth of inspections. This is an important institutional benefit of QRM.

blocks.zh: 共同語言創造相互信任：業界和監管機關用同一套 QRM 語言溝通（如 FMEA、風險矩陣），可以建立 mutual confidence，有助於推動全球一致性的監管決策。
blocks.en: A common language creates mutual trust: when industry and regulators communicate in the same QRM language (such as FMEA and risk matrices), they can build mutual confidence, which supports globally consistent regulatory decisions.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 QRM 整合想像成消防管理系統。一棟大樓有消防灑水器、煙霧偵測器、逃生演練（QRM 工具），這些設備讓消防局（法規機關）對這棟樓有信心——不代表這棟樓可以不遵守建築法規（GMP 義務），但消防局在例行稽查時可能分配更多資源給那些沒有完善系統的大樓。
blocks.en: Think of QRM integration as a fire protection system. A building has sprinklers, smoke detectors and evacuation drills (the QRM tools). These give the fire department (the regulator) confidence in the building. This does not mean the building may ignore building codes (GMP obligations), but during routine inspections the fire department may allocate more resources to buildings without a sound system.

blocks.zh: 而且，如果全市所有建築都用同樣標準的消防系統（共同 QRM 語言），消防局跨區協調也更有效率——這就是「mutual confidence among regulators」的意義。
blocks.en: Moreover, if every building in the city uses the same standard fire protection system (a common QRM language), the fire department can also coordinate across districts more efficiently. This is what "mutual confidence among regulators" means.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 雙向訓練很重要：原文強調 industry AND regulatory personnel 都需要接受 QRM 訓練。這意味著 FDA/EMA 稽查員本身也被期待用 QRM 思維進行稽查決策，而非純粹的逐條核查。
blocks.en: Two-way training matters: the original text stresses that both industry AND regulatory personnel need QRM training. This means FDA/EMA inspectors themselves are expected to apply risk-based thinking in inspection decisions, rather than checking purely clause by clause.

blocks.zh: QRM 的適用範圍非常廣：從開發到供應鏈控制，幾乎涵蓋所有製藥操作。稽查員也可以用 QRM 決定稽查的深度和範圍（risk-based inspection）。
blocks.en: QRM has a very broad scope: from development to supply chain control, it covers almost all pharmaceutical operations. Inspectors can also use QRM to decide the depth and scope of an inspection (risk-based inspection).

blocks.zh: 法規仍為區域性決策：即使有共同 QRM 語言，各地監管機關仍保有區域決策權——這是政治現實，但 QRM 在技術層面促進一致性。
blocks.en: Regulation remains a regional decision: even with a common QRM language, regulators in each region retain their own decision-making authority. This is a political reality, but QRM promotes consistency at the technical level.

blocks.zh: Section 6.1: Product Availability Risks (NEW in R1)｜產品可及性風險（R1 重大新增）
blocks.en: Section 6.1: Product Availability Risks (NEW in R1)

blocks.zh: R1 重大新增：為什麼這一節如此重要？
blocks.en: A major R1 addition: why is this section so important?

blocks.zh: 第 6.1 節是 ICH Q9(R1) 相較於原版 Q9 最重要的新增內容之一。它改變了 QRM 的思維框架：
blocks.en: Section 6.1 is one of the most important additions in ICH Q9(R1) compared with the original Q9. It changes the thinking framework of QRM:

blocks.zh: 原版 Q9 的思維：QRM 是關於「品質風險」——某個缺陷傷害患者的風險
blocks.en: Thinking in the original Q9: QRM is about "quality risk", the risk that a defect harms the patient

blocks.zh: R1 新增的思維：「可及性風險」也是患者傷害的一種——如果藥拿不到，患者同樣受害
blocks.en: New thinking in R1: "availability risk" is also a form of patient harm. If the medicine cannot be obtained, patients are harmed just the same

blocks.zh: 因此：QRM 必須同時考量兩種風險，並在兩者之間取得平衡
blocks.en: Therefore: QRM must consider both kinds of risk and strike a balance between them

blocks.zh: 此概念的引入直接源於 COVID-19 疫情期間的藥品短缺教訓，以及多年來因為 GMP 問題導致的關鍵藥品斷供事件（如抗生素、類固醇、化療藥等）。
blocks.en: This concept came directly from the lessons of drug shortages during the COVID-19 pandemic, and from many years of critical drug supply interruptions caused by GMP problems (for example antibiotics, steroids and chemotherapy drugs).

blocks.zh: 核心比喻：血庫情境 The Blood Bank Analogy
blocks.en: Core analogy: The Blood Bank Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一家醫院血庫發現某批 O 型血的血袋在儲存過程中溫度略有偏差（+1°C 超出規格上限 2 小時）。同時，當天急診室有 3 名嚴重車禍傷患需要大量輸血，且這是醫院目前唯一的 O 型血庫存。
blocks.en: Imagine a hospital blood bank finds that a batch of type O blood bags had a slight temperature deviation during storage (+1°C above the upper specification limit for 2 hours). At the same time, 3 seriously injured car accident patients in the emergency room need large transfusions, and this is the hospital's only type O blood in stock.

blocks.zh: 純品質風險思考（傳統方法）：溫度偏差 → 依 SOP 隔離並銷毀血袋 → 保證品質
blocks.en: Pure quality-risk thinking (the traditional approach): temperature deviation → quarantine and destroy the blood bags per SOP → quality is assured

blocks.zh: QRM 平衡思考（Q9 R1 精神）：
blocks.en: Balanced QRM thinking (the spirit of Q9 R1):

blocks.zh: 品質風險：+1°C 持續 2 小時，對血液品質的實際危害有多大？是否真的超過了安全閾值？
blocks.en: Quality risk: how much actual harm does +1°C for 2 hours do to blood quality? Does it really exceed the safety threshold?

blocks.zh: 可及性風險：若銷毀，3 名傷患無血可用，死亡風險極高
blocks.en: Availability risk: if the blood is destroyed, the 3 patients have no blood available and the risk of death is very high

blocks.zh: 決策：需要用 QRM 框架評估兩個風險的相對嚴重性，而非自動銷毀
blocks.en: Decision: use the QRM framework to evaluate the relative severity of the two risks, rather than destroying the blood automatically

blocks.zh: 這個類比直接對應到製藥情境：一批關鍵抗癌藥發現輕微的標籤偏差，而此藥目前全球短缺——是否應立即召回？
blocks.en: This analogy maps directly onto the pharmaceutical setting: a critical anticancer drug is found to have a minor labeling deviation, and the drug is currently in global shortage. Should it be recalled immediately?

blocks.zh: 三大影響供應可靠性的因素解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the three factors affecting supply reliability

blocks.zh: a) 製程變異性與控制狀態：製程不穩定（如 process drift）不只影響品質，也影響產能和交期——這是供應風險的根源。QRM 應設計能及早偵測偏移的監控系統。
blocks.en: a) Process variability and state of control: an unstable process (such as process drift) affects not only quality but also capacity and delivery time, which is the root of supply risk. QRM should be used to design monitoring systems that detect drift early.

blocks.zh: b) 廠房設備：老化設備、維護不足、設計有人因風險——這些都是供應中斷的前兆。數位化、自動化、隔離技術是降低此類風險的現代手段。
blocks.en: b) Facility and equipment: aging equipment, inadequate maintenance and designs with human-factor risks are all precursors of supply interruption. Digitalization, automation and isolator technology are modern means of reducing such risks.

blocks.zh: c) 外包活動與供應商監管：供應鏈的複雜度帶來「系統性風險」——一個供應商出問題，可能引發連鎖效應。知識管理 + 有效的監控策略 + 備選供應商，是供應鏈韌性的三要素。
blocks.en: c) Outsourced activities and supplier oversight: supply chain complexity brings "systemic risk", where a problem at one supplier can trigger a chain reaction. Knowledge management, an effective monitoring strategy and alternative suppliers are the three elements of supply chain resilience.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application for CDMOs

blocks.zh: CDMO 在可及性風險管理中的雙重角色
blocks.en: The dual role of a CDMO in availability risk management

blocks.zh: CDMO 既是客戶的製造夥伴，也是供應鏈中的關鍵節點。6.1 節對 CDMO 有以下直接影響：
blocks.en: A CDMO is both the manufacturing partner of its client and a critical node in the supply chain. Section 6.1 has the following direct implications for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 合約談判：合約中應包含供應中斷風險評估機制，以及緊急生產優先順序的約定。當客戶的某個產品屬於「關鍵 / 唯一供應來源」藥品，CDMO 需在 QAA（Quality Agreement）中特別標注並納入 QRM 考量。
blocks.en: Contract negotiation: the contract should include a mechanism for assessing supply interruption risk and an agreement on emergency production priority. When a client's product is a "critical / sole-source" drug, the CDMO needs to flag it specifically in the Quality Agreement (QAA) and include it in QRM considerations.

blocks.zh: 批次缺陷決策：若某批次發現輕微缺陷，客戶需決定是否放行。CDMO 應協助客戶進行完整的 QRM：不僅評估缺陷本身的風險，也評估扣留此批次後對患者可及性的風險。這個決策需要記錄在案（有文件的 QRM 決策比主觀判斷更能經得起稽查）。
blocks.en: Batch defect decisions: if a minor defect is found in a batch, the client must decide whether to release it. The CDMO should help the client carry out a complete QRM exercise: assessing not only the risk of the defect itself but also the risk to patient availability if the batch is withheld. This decision needs to be documented (a documented QRM decision withstands inspection better than a subjective judgment).

blocks.zh: 供應商資格管理：CDMO 使用的原輔料供應商若只有單一來源，應依本節精神進行供應中斷風險評估，並建立備用供應商清單。
blocks.en: Supplier qualification management: if a raw material or excipient supplier used by the CDMO is a single source, a supply interruption risk assessment should be performed in the spirit of this section, and a list of backup suppliers should be established.

blocks.zh: 老化設備的供應風險：b) 點直接提醒 CDMO：設備老化不只是 GMP 問題，更是客戶的供應安全問題。設備更新計畫應納入 QRM，向客戶透明揭露。
blocks.en: Supply risk from aging equipment: point b) is a direct reminder to CDMOs that aging equipment is not only a GMP issue but also a supply security issue for the client. Equipment replacement plans should be included in QRM and disclosed transparently to the client.

blocks.zh: 兩風險平衡決策架構 Dual-Risk Decision Framework
blocks.en: Dual-Risk Decision Framework

blocks.zh: 面對「品質缺陷 vs. 供應中斷」的兩難，建議的 QRM 框架如下：
blocks.en: When facing the dilemma of "quality defect vs. supply interruption", the recommended QRM framework is as follows:

blocks.zh:
品質風險評估：
  嚴重性 (Severity)    × 發生機率 (Probability) = 品質風險分數
  → 缺陷導致患者傷害的可能性

可及性風險評估：
  缺藥嚴重性          × 替代可及性            = 可及性風險分數
  → 產品是否唯一供應？患者是否有替代療法？

決策矩陣：
  品質風險高 + 可及性風險低  → 扣留/銷毀（傳統判斷）
  品質風險低 + 可及性風險高  → 有條件放行（需監管機關溝通）
  品質風險高 + 可及性風險高  → 最困難情境，需監管機關參與決策
  品質風險低 + 可及性風險低  → 按常規處理
blocks.en:
Quality risk assessment:
  Severity    × Probability = Quality risk score
  → Likelihood that the defect causes patient harm

Availability risk assessment:
  Shortage severity   × Alternative availability = Availability risk score
  → Is the product the sole supply? Do patients have alternative therapies?

Decision matrix:
  High quality risk + low availability risk  → Withhold/destroy (traditional judgment)
  Low quality risk + high availability risk  → Conditional release (requires communication with the regulator)
  High quality risk + high availability risk → Most difficult scenario, regulator involvement in the decision is needed
  Low quality risk + low availability risk   → Handle routinely

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 正在生產一款用於器官移植後的免疫抑制劑，此藥物目前全球只有 2 家製造商（其中一家已因 GMP 問題暫停生產）。本批次在最終放行測試中發現一項輔料含量略低於規格下限（測定值為規格下限的 99.2%）。作為 QP（合格人員），你如何應用 6.1 節精神做出決策？需要哪些額外評估？
blocks.en: A CDMO is manufacturing an immunosuppressant for post-organ-transplant use. Only 2 manufacturers of this drug exist worldwide (one has already suspended production because of GMP problems). In final release testing, an excipient content in this batch is found slightly below the lower specification limit (the measured value is 99.2% of the lower limit). As the QP (Qualified Person), how would you apply the spirit of Section 6.1 to make a decision? What additional assessments are needed?

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的關鍵壓片機已使用 18 年，維修紀錄顯示過去 6 個月有 3 次非計畫停機。客戶的這個產品是某種常見慢性病的一線用藥，市場需求穩定。依 6.1(b) 精神，CDMO 應如何向客戶呈現這個供應風險，並建議什麼行動？
blocks.en: A CDMO's critical tablet press has been in use for 18 years, and maintenance records show 3 unplanned stoppages in the past 6 months. The client's product is a first-line drug for a common chronic disease with stable market demand. In the spirit of 6.1(b), how should the CDMO present this supply risk to the client, and what actions should it recommend?

blocks.zh: COVID-19 疫情期間，許多國家出現呼吸器藥物（如丙泊酚、咪達唑侖）嚴重短缺。回顧這些短缺事件，哪些符合 6.1(a)、(b)、(c) 所描述的風險因素？如果這些藥廠早期就應用了 6.1 節的 QRM 框架，可能哪些短缺是可以預防的？
blocks.en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, many countries experienced severe shortages of ventilator-related drugs (such as propofol and midazolam). Looking back at these shortages, which fit the risk factors described in 6.1(a), (b) and (c)? If these manufacturers had applied the QRM framework of Section 6.1 early, which shortages might have been preventable?

blocks.zh: Section 7: Definitions｜術語定義
blocks.en: Section 7: Definitions

blocks.zh: 術語體系概覽 Overview of the Definition System
blocks.en: Overview of the Definition System

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 的術語定義構成了 QRM 的語言基礎。理解這些定義的層次關係，對正確執行 QRM 非常重要：
blocks.en: The definitions in Q9(R1) form the linguistic foundation of QRM. Understanding the hierarchy among these definitions is very important for carrying out QRM correctly:

blocks.zh: 危害鏈（Hazard Chain）：Hazard（危害來源）→ 發生後產生 Harm（傷害）→ 傷害的 Severity（嚴重性）是評估的核心維度
blocks.en: Hazard chain: Hazard (the source of harm) → results in Harm when it occurs → the Severity of the harm is the core dimension of assessment

blocks.zh: 風險公式：Risk = Probability × Severity（ISO/IEC Guide 51:2014 來源）
blocks.en: Risk formula: Risk = Probability × Severity (sourced from ISO/IEC Guide 51:2014)

blocks.zh: 評估層次：Hazard Identification → Risk Analysis → Risk Evaluation → 合稱 Risk Assessment
blocks.en: Assessment levels: Hazard Identification → Risk Analysis → Risk Evaluation → together called Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 控制行動：Risk Reduction（降低發生率或嚴重性）→ Risk Control（執行管理決策）→ Risk Acceptance（知情接受剩餘風險）
blocks.en: Control actions: Risk Reduction (reducing probability or severity) → Risk Control (implementing management decisions) → Risk Acceptance (an informed decision to accept the residual risk)

blocks.zh: 監管循環：Risk Review（監控並更新，考慮新知識）
blocks.en: Oversight cycle: Risk Review (monitoring and updating, taking new knowledge into account)

blocks.zh: R1 新增或修訂的重要定義 New/Revised in R1
blocks.en: Important definitions new or revised in R1

blocks.zh: Detectability（可偵測性）：R1 新增。在原版 Q9 中，FMEA 三維度（嚴重性、發生率、可偵測性）在方法工具中提及，但未在定義章節正式定義。R1 將其納入，反映對「能否發現危害」這一維度的重視。
blocks.en: Detectability: new in R1. In the original Q9, the three FMEA dimensions (severity, occurrence, detectability) were mentioned in the methods and tools but not formally defined in the definitions section. R1 includes it, reflecting the importance of the dimension "can the hazard be found?".

blocks.zh: Harm（傷害）：R1 修訂，加入了「loss of product quality or availability」——這是對第 6.1 節精神的配套修訂。原版定義僅提及健康損害，現在明確把「藥品無法取得」也納入傷害的定義範疇。這是 R1 最重要的定義修訂。
blocks.en: Harm: revised in R1 to add "loss of product quality or availability". This is a companion revision to the spirit of Section 6.1. The original definition referred only to damage to health; now "the medicine cannot be obtained" is explicitly included in the scope of harm. This is the most important definition revision in R1.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Decision-Making（基於風險的決策）：R1 新增，強調決策過程需考慮「風險是否已達可接受水準」——與 Section 5 關於正式性和主觀性的討論相呼應。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Decision-Making: new in R1, emphasizing that the decision process needs to consider "whether the risk has reached an acceptable level". This echoes the discussion of formality and subjectivity in Section 5.

blocks.zh: Stakeholder（利害關係人）：R1 新增，明確列出四類主要利害關係人：患者、醫療專業人員、監管機關、業界。這強化了「以患者為中心」的 QRM 精神。
blocks.en: Stakeholder: new in R1, explicitly listing four main groups of stakeholders: patients, healthcare professionals, regulators and industry. This reinforces the patient-centered spirit of QRM.

blocks.zh: Harm 定義修訂的深遠意義
blocks.en: The far-reaching significance of the revised Harm definition

blocks.zh: 原版 Q9 的 Harm 定義：「Damage to health.」
blocks.en: Harm definition in the original Q9: "Damage to health."

blocks.zh: R1 修訂版：「Damage to health, including the damage that can occur from loss of product quality or availability.」
blocks.en: R1 revised version: "Damage to health, including the damage that can occur from loss of product quality or availability."

blocks.zh: 這個修訂看似只加了幾個字，卻具有深刻的實務意涵：
blocks.en: This revision adds only a few words, but it has profound practical implications:

blocks.zh: 「Loss of product quality」傷害：品質缺陷導致療效不足或不良反應
blocks.en: "Loss of product quality" harm: a quality defect leads to insufficient efficacy or adverse reactions

blocks.zh: 「Loss of availability」傷害：藥物無法取得，患者無法得到治療
blocks.en: "Loss of availability" harm: the drug cannot be obtained, and patients cannot receive treatment

blocks.zh: 兩種傷害現在都在 QRM 的管轄範疇之內。這意味著當你在做 Risk Assessment 時，「可及性損失的嚴重性」必須被量化並與「品質缺陷的嚴重性」並列比較。
blocks.en: Both kinds of harm now fall within the scope of QRM. This means that when you perform a Risk Assessment, the "severity of loss of availability" must be quantified and compared side by side with the "severity of a quality defect".

blocks.zh: 在監管稽查中，如果稽查員問你「為什麼決定放行這批有輕微缺陷的貨」，你有文件支撐的 QRM 決策（包含可及性評估）會比沒有文件強得多。
blocks.en: In a regulatory inspection, if the inspector asks, "Why did you decide to release this batch with a minor defect?", a documented QRM decision (including an availability assessment) is far stronger than one without documentation.

blocks.zh: 根據定義，Risk Assessment 包含哪三個子步驟？請各舉一個無菌注射劑製造中的實際例子說明這三個步驟如何執行。
blocks.en: According to the definitions, what three sub-steps does Risk Assessment include? Give one practical example from sterile injectable manufacturing for each, showing how the three steps are carried out.

blocks.zh: 「Risk Acceptance」要求是「informed decision」——什麼樣的文件和證據可以證明一個風險接受決策是「知情的」（informed）？在稽查中，稽查員通常會看哪些記錄？
blocks.en: "Risk Acceptance" requires an "informed decision". What documents and evidence can demonstrate that a risk acceptance decision is "informed"? During an inspection, which records do inspectors usually look at?

blocks.zh: R1 新增了「Detectability」的定義。在 FMEA 中，若一個失效模式的可偵測性很低（例如微生物污染在批次放行測試中很難被發現），應如何優先處理？這和「Severity 無法降低時只能從 Probability 和 Detectability 著手」的思路如何連結？
blocks.en: R1 adds a definition of "Detectability". In FMEA, if a failure mode has very low detectability (for example, microbial contamination is difficult to detect in batch release testing), how should it be prioritized? How does this connect to the idea that "when severity cannot be reduced, you can only work on probability and detectability"?

blocks.zh: 「Stakeholder」的定義列出了四類主要利害關係人。在做一個關於「更換 API 供應商」的風險評估時，每一類利害關係人的主要關注點是什麼？如何確保 Risk Communication 覆蓋所有四類利害關係人？
blocks.en: The definition of "Stakeholder" lists four main groups of stakeholders. In a risk assessment on "changing the API supplier", what are the main concerns of each group? How can you ensure that Risk Communication covers all four groups?

blocks.zh: Section 8: References｜參考文獻
blocks.en: Section 8: References

blocks.zh: 參考文獻體系解析 Reference System Overview
blocks.en: Reference System Overview

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 的參考文獻體系反映了 QRM 的跨學科性質，可以分為四個層次：
blocks.en: The reference system of Q9(R1) reflects the interdisciplinary nature of QRM and can be divided into four levels:

blocks.zh: 第一層：ICH 姊妹指南（#1-4）：Q8（開發）、Q10（品質系統）、Q11（藥物物質開發）、Q12（生命週期管理）——這四份指南與 Q9 共同構成「QbD 四聯體」，應整合理解，不能孤立閱讀。
blocks.en: Level 1: Sister ICH guidelines (#1-4): Q8 (development), Q10 (quality system), Q11 (development of drug substances) and Q12 (lifecycle management). Together with Q9, these four guidelines form the "QbD quartet" and should be understood in an integrated way, not read in isolation.

blocks.zh: 第二層：ISO/IEC 基礎標準（#5-14）：Q9 的風險公式和許多定義直接引用 ISO 標準，尤其是 Guide 51 和 Guide 73。IEC 系列標準為 FTA、FMEA、HAZOP 等工具提供技術基礎。ISO 7870 系列則支撐統計製程控制（SPC）。
blocks.en: Level 2: ISO/IEC foundation standards (#5-14): the risk formula and many definitions in Q9 are cited directly from ISO standards, especially Guide 51 and Guide 73. The IEC series provides the technical basis for tools such as FTA, FMEA and HAZOP. The ISO 7870 series supports statistical process control (SPC).

blocks.zh: 第三層：HACCP 與品質管理經典（#15-18）：從食品安全借鑒的 HACCP 方法論、石川馨的全面品質控制、FMEA 教科書——這反映了製藥 QRM 借鑒自其他高風險行業的思想淵源。
blocks.en: Level 3: HACCP and classic quality management (#15-18): the HACCP methodology borrowed from food safety, Kaoru Ishikawa's total quality control, and FMEA textbooks. These reflect the intellectual roots of pharmaceutical QRM in other high-risk industries.

blocks.zh: 第四層：R1 新增的行業參考（#19-25）：PDA TR54、TR68、PDA 老化設備 PTC、ISPE 藥品短缺調查——這些是直接支撐 R1 新增內容（尤其是 6.1 節）的行業文獻，體現了 R1 修訂過程中的證據基礎。
blocks.en: Level 4: Industry references added in R1 (#19-25): PDA TR54, TR68, the PDA aging facilities PTC, and the ISPE drug shortage survey. These are industry documents that directly support the new content in R1 (especially Section 6.1) and reflect the evidence base of the R1 revision process.

blocks.zh: 重點參考文獻深度解析 Key References in Depth
blocks.en: Key References in Depth

blocks.zh: ISO 14971:2019（醫療器械風險管理）：雖然是針對醫療器械的標準，但其風險管理流程與製藥 QRM 高度相似，常被製藥業作為 QRM 實施的參考模型。許多稽查員熟悉此標準，了解它可以幫助你與稽查員建立共同語言。
blocks.en: ISO 14971:2019 (risk management for medical devices): although a standard for medical devices, its risk management process is highly similar to pharmaceutical QRM and is often used by the pharmaceutical industry as a reference model for QRM implementation. Many inspectors are familiar with this standard, and knowing it can help you build a common language with them.

blocks.zh: PDA TR68（藥品短缺 QRM）：2014 年發佈，是 6.1 節概念的直接前身。TR68 詳細描述了如何應用 QRM 框架來預防和管理藥品短缺，對 CDMO 而言是必讀文件。
blocks.en: PDA TR68 (QRM for drug shortages): published in 2014, it is the direct predecessor of the concept in Section 6.1. TR68 describes in detail how to apply the QRM framework to prevent and manage drug shortages, and is a must-read for CDMOs.

blocks.zh: O'Donnell et al. (2020)——「Understanding the concept of formality」：直接為 R1 第 5.1 節（關於 QRM 正式性）的修訂提供學術依據。這篇文章提出了評估 QRM 活動「需要多正式」的決策框架。
blocks.en: O'Donnell et al. (2020), "Understanding the concept of formality": provides the academic basis for the R1 revision of Section 5.1 (on formality in QRM). The article proposes a decision framework for assessing "how formal" a QRM activity needs to be.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12（生命週期管理）：R1 新增引用，反映 QRM 在產品後期（上市後變更、延伸有效期等）的應用越來越受重視。Q12 中的 PACMP（批准後變更管理協議）是 QRM 應用的重要新場景。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 (lifecycle management): a new reference in R1, reflecting the growing importance of QRM in the later stages of a product (post-approval changes, shelf-life extension and so on). The PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol) in Q12 is an important new scenario for applying QRM.

blocks.zh: CDMO 必讀文獻推薦
blocks.en: Recommended Reading for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 專業人員，以下參考文獻優先閱讀：
blocks.en: For CDMO professionals, the following references should be read first:

blocks.zh: PDA TR54（#19）：製藥和生技製造 QRM 實施的實務指南，包含大量 CDMO 相關情境
blocks.en: PDA TR54 (#19): a practical guide to implementing QRM in pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing, with many CDMO-relevant scenarios

blocks.zh: PDA TR68（#21）：藥品短缺的 QRM 應對——與 CDMO 的供應穩定性直接相關
blocks.en: PDA TR68 (#21): QRM response to drug shortages, directly relevant to CDMO supply stability

blocks.zh: PDA 老化設備 PTC（#20）：CDMO 普遍面臨設備老化問題，此文件提供了基於風險的設備老化評估框架
blocks.en: PDA aging facilities PTC (#20): CDMOs commonly face aging equipment, and this document provides a risk-based framework for assessing aging equipment

blocks.zh: ICH Q10（#2）：CDMO 的品質協議（QAA）和委託方/受託方關係的管理，在 Q10 的框架下才能完整理解 QRM 的制度性整合
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (#2): the CDMO quality agreement (QAA) and the management of the contract giver/acceptor relationship can only be fully understood within the Q10 framework, which is how QRM is institutionally integrated

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Section 6 — QRM 整合的雙向性：QRM 同時整合於業界操作（開發、生產、供應鏈等）與法規操作（稽查、審查）；雙方共用 QRM 語言可建立互信，但不取代法規合規義務
blocks.en: Section 6: the two-way nature of QRM integration: QRM is integrated into both industry operations (development, production, supply chain and so on) and regulatory operations (inspection, assessment); a shared QRM language between both sides builds mutual trust but does not replace regulatory compliance obligations

blocks.zh: Section 6.1 — R1 最重大新增：「可及性風險」正式納入 QRM 範疇；當品質/製造問題威脅藥品供應時，斷藥本身即為患者傷害；QRM 必須平衡品質風險與可及性風險，兩者不能偏廢
blocks.en: Section 6.1: the most significant R1 addition: "availability risk" is formally brought into the scope of QRM; when quality/manufacturing problems threaten drug supply, the shortage itself is patient harm; QRM must balance quality risk and availability risk, and neither can be neglected

blocks.zh: 三大供應風險因素：(a) 製程變異性、(b) 廠房設備老化、(c) 外包活動監管不足——這三者都可通過 QRM 前瞻性識別與預防
blocks.en: Three supply risk factors: (a) process variability, (b) aging facilities and equipment, (c) inadequate oversight of outsourced activities. All three can be identified and prevented proactively through QRM

blocks.zh: Section 7 — R1 關鍵定義修訂：Harm 定義新增「loss of availability」；新增 Detectability、Risk-Based Decision-Making、Stakeholder 三個定義；這些修訂與 6.1 節精神互相呼應
blocks.en: Section 7: key definition revisions in R1: the Harm definition adds "loss of availability"; three new definitions are added: Detectability, Risk-Based Decision-Making and Stakeholder; these revisions echo the spirit of Section 6.1

blocks.zh: 術語層次關係：Hazard → Harm（Severity）；Risk = P × Severity；Risk Assessment = Hazard ID + Risk Analysis + Risk Evaluation；風險管理循環包含評估、控制、溝通、審查四個核心活動
blocks.en: Hierarchy of terms: Hazard → Harm (Severity); Risk = P × Severity; Risk Assessment = Hazard ID + Risk Analysis + Risk Evaluation; the risk management cycle includes four core activities: assessment, control, communication and review

blocks.zh: Section 8 — 參考文獻結構：ICH 姊妹指南（Q8/Q10/Q11/Q12）+ ISO/IEC 基礎標準 + PDA/ISPE 行業文獻；R1 新增的行業文獻直接支撐第 6.1 節的理論依據
blocks.en: Section 8: structure of the references: sister ICH guidelines (Q8/Q10/Q11/Q12) + ISO/IEC foundation standards + PDA/ISPE industry documents; the industry documents added in R1 directly support the rationale of Section 6.1
